login.welcomeLead: Sign in to your Masahati account and explore the best spaces available to you in one place.
login.welcomeBullet1: Manage your bookings and spaces easily
login.welcomeBullet2: Track your payments and reports in real time
login.title: Log in
login.sub: Enter your details to access your account.

signup.welcomeLead: Join Masahati and start managing or booking the best spaces available to you in one place.
signup.welcomeBullet1: Quick sign-up in a few simple steps
signup.welcomeBullet2: An option for space owners with document verification
signup.sub: Sign up for Masahati — we'll verify your email.
signup.proofHint: Attach a document proving you own a space (title deed / lease / license) — optional
signup.passwordPlaceholder: At least 8 characters with an uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character
signup.errProofUpload: Failed to upload the ownership document. Check the file and try again.
signup.errOwnerRegister: Couldn't complete the owner registration. Please try again.
signup.errNoToken: Couldn't start verification: the server didn't return a registration token.
signup.errFixFields: Please correct the fields marked below.
signup.errGeneric: Couldn't create the account. Please try again.
signup.errGoogleLogin: Couldn't log in with Google. Please try again.
signup.errGoogleSignup: Couldn't create the account with Google. Please try again.

forgot.welcomeLead: Enter your email and we'll send you a secure link to reset your password. Open the link from your inbox to create a new password.
forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.sub: Enter your email to receive a secure link to reset your password.
forgot.sentBefore: We sent the password reset link to
forgot.sentAfter: . Check your inbox (and spam) and open the link.
forgot.errEmailFormat: Please enter a valid email address.
forgot.errUnexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
forgot.errEmailUnregistered: This email isn't registered with us or is incorrect.
forgot.errThrottled: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
forgot.errNetwork: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

reset.welcomeLead: Create a strong password for your Masahati account. Make sure both fields match before saving.
reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subPlain: Enter your email and new password for your account.
reset.errorUnexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
reset.invalidLead: The reset link is invalid or expired. Request a new link from the forgot password page.
reset.errBadMethod: The reset link was opened incorrectly. Copy the link and open it in the browser, or request a new one.
reset.errUnexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
reset.errToken: The reset link is invalid or expired. Request a new link.
reset.errEmailInvalid: This email is incorrect. Request a new link.
reset.errNetwork: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
